name: fate-engine
description: 全域超验无限命运演算系统 · V13 工程化落地（分阶段开发）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fate/server" "npm run dev -w @fate/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fate/server && npm run build -w @fate/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @fate/server && npm run lint -w @fate/web
scripts.verify: npm run verify -w @fate/server && npm run test -w @fate/web
